label: Week 6
method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-16T01:09Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Friday of Week 6, the night after DEN beat SEA 17-14 in OT on TNF. Volume landed for all 32 clubs. Loudest rooms: DEN, SEA (TNF afterglow), PHI, DAL, BUF, NE, CLE, SF, CHI, BAL. CIN, LV, MIA quiet after filter. Dropped mostly college football (Ohio State-Indiana, Texas-Florida, CFP 24-team expansion, eligibility court rulings, Tennessee-Alabama, Oregon QB), MLB/NBA/NHL/WNBA/F1/NASCAR, Dennis Green 2006 rant and Vick Madden nostalgia, Patriots all-blue uniform post, Kittle shirt, Quinn cap, Amazon orange line-of-scrimmage gripe, Darnold memes, WIP Hurts-for-Herbert radio poll, Mevis Instagram backlash, JuJu non-visit, and heavy cross-club near-dupes (Week 6 betting buzz, primetime OT streak, Kalshi playoff odds, draft board).

items.title: Jeremiyah Love ruled out vs. Rams (ankle)
items.one_line: LaFleur says the ankle hasn't improved after a full week of missed practice; Tyler Allgeier leads the backfield.

items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. traded to Houston
items.one_line: Cardinals send Harrison Jr. to the Texans for 2027 draft picks.

items.title: #BidwillOut billboards go up
items.one_line: Fans raised nearly $8k on GoFundMe for Phoenix billboards demanding Michael Bidwill sell the team.

items.title: Penix fully cleared for Bears
items.one_line: Penix practiced without limits after the rib injury and says he feels good; Caleb Williams is questionable on the other side.

items.title: Pundits pick Falcons over Bears
items.one_line: ESPN's Get Up panel mostly backed the 2-3 Falcons at home; Bears fans pushed back online.

items.title: Lamar ruled out vs. Browns (ankle)
items.one_line: Jackson misses a second straight game; Tyler Huntley starts again after winning in Atlanta.

items.title: Lamar vs. Allen résumé debate
items.one_line: Allen's 100th career win reopened the Lamar-vs-Allen argument while Jackson sits.

items.title: Five Bills questionable vs. Raiders
items.one_line: DJ Moore, Ed Oliver, Joshua Palmer, Dee Alford and T.J. Sanders are questionable; Spencer Brown upgraded to full.

items.title: Allen tops MVP odds
items.one_line: Josh Allen sits around +250 to +292 for MVP after 121 rushing yards in the OT win over the Rams.

items.title: Allen hits 100 career wins
items.one_line: Allen became the fourth QB to reach 100 wins in his first nine seasons, fueling the Lamar comparison.

items.title: Panthers catch Eagles without Hurts
items.one_line: Philly ruled out Hurts (calf blood clot) and Barkley (hamstring) for Sunday; Tanner McKee starts vs. Carolina.

items.title: Caleb Williams questionable but on track
items.one_line: Full practice all week off the Week 2 hamstring; Ben Johnson calls him on track for Atlanta.

items.title: Pundits pick Falcons over Bears
items.one_line: Get Up panel mostly sided with Atlanta; Bears fans called it disrespect.

items.title: Concepcion and Sampson back
items.one_line: Rookie WR KC Concepcion cleared concussion protocol and RB Dylan Sampson came off IR for the Ravens game.

items.title: Shedeur watch if Watson slips
items.one_line: Watson is efficient (94.1 rating) but the Browns lead the league with 19 sacks allowed; local media eye Sanders.

items.title: Browns get Ravens without Lamar
items.one_line: Baltimore ruled out Jackson; Tyler Huntley starts in Cleveland.

items.title: Overshown a long shot at Lambeau
items.one_line: Schottenheimer called Overshown (hamstring) a long shot; Cobie Durant and Drew Shelton are out.

items.title: Mike Pettine joins the defensive staff
items.one_line: Added as senior defensive assistant in the booth to back first-year DC Christian Parker.

items.title: Parker stays on the field for now
items.one_line: Schottenheimer says moving Parker upstairs isn't final after Jerry Jones floated it.

items.title: Broncos beat Seahawks 17-14 in OT
items.one_line: Five sacks of Darnold, two picks and a 53-yard Lutz walk-off; Denver is 4-2.

items.title: Fitzpatrick rips Bo Nix
items.one_line: Nix went 17 of 27 for 107 yards with a 20-year-low 4.9 air yards per pass; Fitzpatrick called it uncompetitive.

items.title: Waddle shoulder scare, returned
items.one_line: Jaylen Waddle left TNF with a shoulder issue and came back into the game.

items.title: DeAndre Carter to practice squad
items.one_line: Lions add the veteran returner after Kennedy's season-ending injury and surgery.

items.title: Goff: 12 TDs, zero picks
items.one_line: Goff joins Russell Wilson as the only QBs with that line through five games.

items.title: Hargrave and Ford out vs. Dallas
items.one_line: Packers have four outs including DTs Javon Hargrave and Jonathan Ford; Keisean Nixon plays through a groin injury.

items.title: Jacobs off the exempt list Oct. 19
items.one_line: Josh Jacobs becomes eligible for Week 7 vs. Detroit; the conduct-policy investigation stays open.

items.title: Jacobs sues to block police video
items.one_line: Jacobs filed for an injunction against releasing records from his May altercation.

items.title: Marvin Harrison Jr. trade lands
items.one_line: Houston acquired Harrison Jr. from Arizona for 2027 picks; he debuts in London on a limited snap count.

items.title: Dell, Montgomery, Pitre out in London
items.one_line: Tank Dell (knee), David Montgomery (groin) and Jalen Pitre (shoulder) are ruled out vs. Jacksonville.

items.title: London AFC South clash with Jaguars
items.one_line: Wembley matchup with the division-leading Jags is the room's main storyline.

items.title: Tyler Warren questionable (groin)
items.one_line: The TE popped up with a groin issue in practice; Will Mallory is also questionable (thumb).

items.title: Darius Slayton released
items.one_line: Colts cut the veteran WR after 24 days, citing the learning curve and a knee issue.

items.title: 'Grocery stick' label sticks
items.one_line: Big Cat's tag (18 losses in 21 vs. winning teams) follows the Colts into the Titans game; Ballard's deal is expiring.

items.title: Texans next in London
items.one_line: Fresh off the London win over Philly, the Jags hold a slim AFC South lead heading into Wembley.

items.title: Texans down Dell, Montgomery, Pitre
items.one_line: Houston ruled out three starters for the London game.

items.title: Rice and Simmons out vs. Chargers
items.one_line: Reid confirmed Rashee Rice (hamstring) and LT Josh Simmons (back) are out; Sneed is questionable (knee).

items.title: Kenneth Walker's hot start
items.one_line: Walker already has three 100-yard games for KC after Seattle let him walk.

items.title: Alt, James among five out vs. KC
items.one_line: Joe Alt, Kayode Awosika, Tre' Harris, Donte Jackson and Derwin James are ruled out; McConkey and Johnston cleared.

items.title: Alec Ingold to IR
items.one_line: Fullback out at least four games with a shoulder injury; 28 of 53 players are hurt or on IR.

items.title: 49ers ask about Khalil Mack
items.one_line: Kittle pushed for Mack and SF is making calls; Mack reportedly wants to stay with the 0-5 Chargers.

items.title: McDuffie and Curl questionable
items.one_line: Trent McDuffie (groin) and Kam Curl (ankle) are questionable vs. Arizona; Davis Allen cleared.

items.title: Reichard perfect on 15 FGs
items.one_line: NFL Films spotlight on Will Reichard: 15 for 15 this year, five from 50-plus.

items.title: Pats -7 to -7.5 vs. Jets, public all in
items.one_line: About 94% of moneyline bets on New England at Gillette.

items.title: Three RBs tried out
items.one_line: Patriots worked out Terrell Jennings, Ulysses Bentley and Josh Pitsenberger with Henderson questionable.

items.title: Benson hugs Moore at practice
items.one_line: Owner Gayle Benson visited practice after calling 1-4 'unacceptable'; Moore says the relationship is solid.

items.title: Shough avoiding the middle
items.one_line: Zero middle-of-field completions in recent weeks despite a 74.6 PFF grade.

items.title: Thomas, Eluemunor, Carter back at practice
items.one_line: All three returned Friday and are questionable vs. the Saints; CB Colton Hood is out (concussion).

items.title: Nabers at 70-80 percent
items.one_line: Malik Nabers says he still has 20-30% to go off the knee injury despite a 20-target game.

items.title: Breece Hall out, Omar Cooper back
items.one_line: Hall (quad) and Adonai Mitchell (finger) are out at New England; rookie Cooper returns from the high ankle sprain.

items.title: Jets +7 with the public on NE
items.one_line: About 94% of moneyline bets are on the Patriots.

items.title: David Bailey leads rookie pass rushers
items.one_line: Bailey leads all rookies in sacks and pressures after ditching social media.

items.title: Hurts out (calf blood clot), McKee starts
items.one_line: Barkley also misses a second game with the hamstring; DeVonta Smith returns vs. Carolina.

items.title: Eagles sign Joe Milton
items.one_line: QB pulled off Dallas' practice squad as Hurts sits indefinitely.

items.title: Metcalf questionable, WRs thin
items.one_line: Roman Wilson, Ben Skowronek and DeShon Elliott are out; DK Metcalf questionable (illness) vs. Tampa.

items.title: Jaylen Warren's record day
items.one_line: First Steeler with an 80-yard receiving TD and a 50-yard rushing TD in one game, in the win over Indy.

items.title: OT loss in Denver drops SEA to 3-3
items.one_line: Darnold sacked five times with two picks, the last in overtime.

items.title: Walker thriving in KC
items.one_line: Ex-Seahawk Kenneth Walker has three 100-yard games; Seattle's backs have none.

items.title: Christian Kirk's window opened
items.one_line: Kirk practiced limited for the first time since July; Deebo Samuel and Mike Evans are banged up.

items.title: Kittle lobbies for Khalil Mack
items.one_line: Lynch confirms SF is making and fielding calls ahead of the Nov. 10 deadline.

items.title: Mayfield out (thumb)
items.one_line: Baker Mayfield, Antoine Winfield Jr. and David Sills V are out at Pittsburgh; Benjamin Morrison doubtful.

items.title: CEO apologizes to fans
items.one_line: Burke Nihill answered a fan-frustration survey with an apology and new fan meetings while backing the coach and GM.

items.title: Backfield banged up for SF
items.one_line: Croskey-Merritt (groin) missed again; Ekeler and Rachaad White limited; Devin Neal promoted.

items.title: Daniels owns the clock blunder
items.one_line: Daniels took the blame for the end-of-OT mistake in the 27-27 tie with the Giants.
